summary_1line: Vibhishana reassures a grieving Rama that Sita’s killing was an illusion by Indrajit and reveals the prince’s sacrificial ritual at Nikumbhila.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vibhishana approaches the battlefield where Rama sits stunned with grief while monkeys stand around him with tear-filled eyes.
Lakshmana announces that Indrajit has slain Sita as the gathered warriors react in shock and despair.
Vibhishana urgently tells Rama that the slain Sita was an illusion and points toward the distant sacrificial ground of Nikumbhila.
